friendly_name: Nightly red: test seams after origin freshness
purpose_context: The 2026-10-08 nightly went red in 16 tests across three groups. Research bisected each to PR #5845 (#5780) and found the product behaviour intended and the test seams stale; this mission re-pins the seams so the nightly is an honest signal again.
purpose_tldr: Re-pin four nightly test seams that drifted when origin freshness landed (#5845)
